XECH Fast 15W Wireless Charger – Smart Charging for Multiple Devices

The XECH Wireless Charging solution is designed for modern users who need fast, reliable, and clutter-free power every day. Built to charge multiple devices efficiently, this advanced charging station combines a Fast 15W Wireless Charger, a practical smartphone stand, and a pen & pencil holder into one elegant desktop accessory.

Powered with Input Power – 18W and delivering an optimized Wireless Output Power – 15W, the charger ensures stable, fast, and safe charging for Qi-enabled smartphones. Whether at home, in the office, or at a workstation, the helps you stay powered and organized without tangled cables.

Fast & Efficient Wireless Charging Performance

Designed with intelligent power management, this automatically detects compatible devices and delivers optimal charging speed. The powerful Type-C input port supports consistent power flow, while advanced safety protection prevents overheating, overcharging, and voltage fluctuation. The wireless output power of 15W ensures faster charging compared to standard wireless pads, making it ideal for daily use. Simply place your smartphone on the stand and enjoy seamless, cable-free power delivery.

Charge Multiple Devices with USB & Type-C Output Ports

In addition to wireless charging, the charger features Output Ports: USB & Type-C, allowing you to charge multiple devices simultaneously. Power your smartphone wirelessly while charging earbuds, smartwatches, or accessories via cable. This makes the charger a perfect multi-device charging station for users who rely on several gadgets throughout the day. One charger, one power source, and complete convenience.

Smartphone Stand with Built-In Pen & Pencil Holder

More than just a charger, this product doubles as a smartphone stand with a pen & pencil holder. The upright design allows hands-free viewing for video calls, streaming, or notifications, while keeping your desk clean and professional. The integrated pen holder helps organize stationery, making it an ideal choice for offices, study desks, and work-from-home setups. The compact yet functional design saves space while enhancing productivity.

Modern Design with Premium Build Quality

Crafted with a sleek and minimal design, the blends easily with modern interiors. The anti-slip base ensures stability during charging, while the durable construction offers long-lasting performance. Whether you are looking for a reliable charging solution or a stylish desk accessory, this charger meets both functional and aesthetic needs.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Brand: XECH
  • Product Type: Fast Wireless Charger with Smartphone Stand
  • Input Power: 18W
  • Wireless Output Power: 15W
  • Input Port: Type-C
  • Output Ports: USB & Type-C
  • Supports charging multiple devices at the same time
  • Built-in pen & pencil holder for desk organization
  • Qi-compatible fast wireless charging
  • Ideal for office, home, and workstation use

Why Choose?

The offers a perfect balance of speed, safety, and style. With support for multiple device charging, efficient power output, and a smart stand design, it is a reliable solution for today’s connected lifestyle. Upgrade your charging experience with a powerful, space-saving, and versatile designed to keep your devices ready whenever you need them.
